definitions.rationale: This nullary equation expands the named loop-body proof term to the exact translated statement AST; it defines syntax and does not implement an execution step or assert an additional mathematical fact.
definitions.text:
rule #fixSpacesLoopBody
    => If(
         Compare(Name("char"), CmpOp("==", Str(" "))),
         If(
           Compare(Name("spaces"), CmpOp("==", Str("__"))),
           Assign(Name("spaces"), Str("-")),
           If(
             Compare(Name("spaces"), CmpOp("!=", Str("-"))),
             AugAssign(Name("spaces"), "+", Str("_")),
             .Stmts)),
         AugAssign(
           Name("result"),
           "+",
           BinOp("+", Name("spaces"), Name("char")))
         Assign(Name("spaces"), Str("")))

definitions.rationale: This nullary equation expands the named function-body proof term to the exact translated function AST, after which the supplied operational semantics executes that AST.
definitions.text:
rule #fixSpacesBody
    => Assign(Name("result"), Str(""))
       Assign(Name("spaces"), Str(""))
       Assign(Name("char"), Str(""))
       For(Name("char"), Name("text"), #fixSpacesLoopBody)
       Return(BinOp("+", Name("result"), Name("spaces")))

definitions.rationale: This is the guarded defining case of pendingSpace for the two-underscore encoding, mapping the next space to the saturated dash encoding.
definitions.text:
rule pendingSpace(P:IntSeq)
    => iCons(45, .IntSeq)
    requires P ==K iCons(95, iCons(95, .IntSeq))

definitions.rationale: This is the guarded defining case of pendingSpace that keeps an already saturated dash encoding unchanged.
definitions.text:
rule pendingSpace(P:IntSeq)
    => P
    requires P ==K iCons(45, .IntSeq)
     andBool notBool (P ==K iCons(95, iCons(95, .IntSeq)))

definitions.rationale: This is the remaining guarded defining case of pendingSpace, appending one underscore when the pending encoding is neither two underscores nor a dash.
definitions.text:
rule pendingSpace(P:IntSeq)
    => seqConcat(P, iCons(95, .IntSeq))
    requires notBool (P ==K iCons(95, iCons(95, .IntSeq)))
     andBool notBool (P ==K iCons(45, .IntSeq))

definitions.rationale: This base equation defines resultAfter on an empty remaining character sequence as the current completed result.
This recurrence defines resultAfter for a leading space by consuming that character, preserving the completed result, and updating the pending-space summary.
definitions.text:
rule resultAfter(iCons(32, CS:IntSeq), R:IntSeq, P:IntSeq)
    => resultAfter(CS, R, pendingSpace(P))

definitions.rationale: Although marked simplification, this is the guarded non-space recurrence that defines resultAfter by consuming one character, flushing the pending encoding, and resetting it; it is not an independent lemma.
definitions.text:
rule resultAfter(iCons(C:Int, CS:IntSeq), R:IntSeq, P:IntSeq)
    => resultAfter(
         CS,
         seqConcat(R, seqConcat(P, iCons(C, .IntSeq))),
         .IntSeq)
    requires C =/=Int 32
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: This base equation defines pendingAfter on an empty remaining sequence as the current pending-space encoding.
This recurrence defines pendingAfter for a leading space by consuming the character and applying the pendingSpace state transition.
definitions.text:
rule pendingAfter(iCons(32, CS:IntSeq), P:IntSeq)
    => pendingAfter(CS, pendingSpace(P))

definitions.rationale: Although marked simplification, this is the guarded non-space recurrence that defines pendingAfter by consuming one character and resetting the pending encoding; it is not an independent lemma.
definitions.text:
rule pendingAfter(iCons(C:Int, CS:IntSeq), _P:IntSeq)
    => pendingAfter(CS, .IntSeq)
    requires C =/=Int 32
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: This base equation defines charAfter on an empty remaining sequence as the existing loop-target value.
This recurrence defines charAfter by consuming one code and recording its one-character string as the latest loop-target value.
This equation defines fixedSpaces as the concatenation of the recursively defined final completed-result and pending-space summaries.
